strongest_angle: Examining the geopolitical fallout and energy security implications as German prosecutors officially begin trial proceedings blaming Ukrainian state authorities for the Nord Stream pipeline explosions.

key_facts.fact: A former Ukrainian army officer named Serhii K goes on trial in Germany accused of commanding the Nord Stream pipeline explosions in September 2022.
German prosecutors are officially blaming Ukrainian state authorities for the sabotage that ruptured three of the four Nord Stream gas pipelines beneath the Baltic Sea.
The trial opened in Germany four years after the undersea explosions damaged the major energy infrastructure transporting gas between Russia and Germany.

numbers.label: Years between the 2022 explosions and the 2026 trial opening
